text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating remediation owners + what we need added to the evals/regression suites. Trying to keep this tight so we can put tasks into the sprint board.

alex: TL;DR: KV-cache eviction regression, new promptset for graceful fallback, sustained+burst load tests, and a scoped chaos drill. Propose owners + deadlines below.

maria: I can own the KV cache eviction regression. Will add a failing test that reproduces TTL+eviction at ~99% traffic. Target: PR by next Wed.

cheng: I'll take the fallback promptset. I'll pull incidents & write ~15 prompts that exercised the bad decode paths. Goal: first draft by Fri EOD.

sam: I'll do sustained load + burst profile. Need to know which VM/GPU shapes to simulate (dedicated vs hosted). I can get preliminary results in 2 weeks.

tayler: For chaos drill, eng-oncall should run it with platform help. I can coordinate runbooks and the post-drill checklist. Suggest slot during next oncall rotation (2 weeks out).

alex: Thanks — can everyone paste GH/JIRA links once they create tasks? I'll add tickets to the postmortem swimlane. Also we should add each test to the CI gating matrix (opt-out for private deploys).

maria: JIRA: RI-4231 (kv-eviction-regression). PR prefix in repo: tests/evans/kv_eviction_regress. Example repro command I added to the ticket:
```bash
python tools/eval_runner.py --suite kv_eviction --concurrency 200 --duration 600
```

cheng: JIRA: RI-4240 (fallback-promptset). Promptset stored in repo under evals/promptsets/fallback_incidents/ with README. Will link soon.

sam: JIRA: RI-4253 (sustained-burst-load). I'll run against the dedicated staging pool first. Planning to include autoscaling triggers and latency SLOs in the test harness.

tayler: JIRA: RI-4260 (chaos-drill-kv-fallthrough). I'll schedule and ping eng-oncall. Proposed play: turn off one replica + inject 50% latency on region B during peak traffic window.

devex-bot: Reminder: add labels `postmortem-action`, `eval-required`, and `blocking-ci` where applicable.

oncall-bot: Deploy note: previous fix for KV mismatch deployed 3 days ago — keep in mind when reproducing.

alex: A few open questions: 1) We need acceptance criteria for each test (what pass/fail looks like). 2) Do we want to add regression to nightly only or gate PRs? 3) Any small, quick mitigations we can ship before tests are done?

maria: Acceptance for KV regression = no >1% regression in tail-latency for 95-99th under eviction scenarios + no OOMs.

cheng: For promptset, acceptance = identical or improved fallback rate vs current baseline on the 15 prompts + no increase in harmful hallucinations.

sam: Load tests: acceptance = autoscaler keeps p95 latency < 300ms on steady state and recovers within 60s after a 3x burst.

tayler: Chaos drill acceptance = runbook completes without manual escalation + CR on-call resolves simulated outage within SLA window.

alex: For gating: My vote is add KV eviction regression as blocking for PRs touching runtime/cache and nightly for infra changes. Promptset run nightly + spot-check in PRs for changes to reranking/decoding. Load tests stay nightly.

maria: Agree on the gating plan. I'll add an ENV var so we can opt into heavy tests on CI run.

cheng: I'll add people for review on the promptset (eng-ml + trust & safety).

sam: I'll post preliminary harness configs in the ticket and tag infra for needed staging capacity.

tayler: I'll create the drill calendar invite once JIRA is confirmed.

alex: Can we set tentative deadlines: KV PR by Wed (next week), promptset Fri, load test configs in 2 weeks, chaos drill scheduled within 3 weeks? If anyone can't meet, please flag now.

maria: Confirmed.

cheng: Confirmed.

sam: Slight risk on staging capacity but aiming for 2-week deliverable for configs.

tayler: Confirmed for the drill slot.

alex: Great. I'll update the postmortem with owners, deadlines, and the JIRA links. Also adding a follow-up sync in the retro channel in 7 days to check progress. :thumbsup:

maria: Will add the failing case to the regression harness and tag you when PR is ready.

cheng: Linking promptset once cleaned.

sam: Will coordinate with infra and tag you all.

tayler: I'll own the drill checklist and runbook updates.

alex: Thanks everyone. End of thread.
